title: oily malaysian pork kambing
description: juicy pork kambing dish inspired by malaysian flavors, perfect for a post-workout meal with pineapple and a sweet and spicy glaze.

ingredients.name: glaze
ingredients.notes: equal parts pineapple juice, soy sauce, and honey

instructions: in a blender or food processor, puree the glaze ingredients until well combined.
place the pork shoulder on a rimmed baking sheet lined with aluminum foil, leaving space to add the pineapple chunks later.
rub the pork with olive oil, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
place the pork in the oven and roast for 30 minutes, or until browned on all sides.
after 30 minutes, add the pineapple chunks to the baking sheet and continue to roast for an additional 15 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and the pineapple is caramelized.
remove the pork from the oven and brush the glaze all over the top.
return the pork to the oven and broil for 2-3 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized and sticky.
remove the pork from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
